title: PosOrder

uuid.description: The globally unique identity of the order. This is the primary and only guaranteed unique identity.

order_number.description: A more human-readable order number to show to the customer and merchant For standard and catering orders, this is equivalent to the parent_order_number. For group orders, this is the number related to the orders at that specific restaurant as a subset of the larger group order This is not guaranteed to be unique forever and is thus not used as a true identifier from an API perspective.

parent_order_number.description: A more human-readable order number to show to the driver This will be the order number displayed on the Grubhub Driver App. This is not guaranteed to be unique forever and is thus not used as a true identifier from an API perspective.

is_test.description: If true, this is a test order and should not actually be prepared

status.description:
The status of an order as it passes through the Grubhub fulfillment flow.

ANTICIPATED: denotes a future order, which may be cancelled by diner.
RESTAURANT_CONFIRMABLE: pending confirmation of receipt by the restaurant. These are effectively new ASAP orders. ANTICIPATED orders will automatically become RESTAURANT_CONFIRMABLE at the promise time, less the restaurant's configured pickup or delivery prep time.
DINER_CONFIRMABLE: a status held for future use.
CONFIRMED: denotes that the order was received by restaurant, even if the restaurant is unable to fulfill it.
REJECTED: an error status. For example, if an order is unable to be inserted to the POS, due to menu item mismatch, restaurant offline, etc., the status should be updated to REJECTED. This is not to be used when the order was successfully transmitted, but the restaurant is unable to fulfill it for operational reasons. In that scenario, a Change Request should be submitted to cancel the order.
CANCELLED: a cancellation request by the diner or restaurant has been processed by Grubhub Customer Care.
PICKUP_READY: indicates that the food is prepared and ready for pickup by the diner or a Grubhub delivery courier.
OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: the food is on the way to the diner.
FULFILLED: denotes that the food has been delivered to or picked up by the diner.
UNKNOWN: provided for error handling of strings unmappable to known enumeration values.

statusHistory.description: A list of all status updates for this order

merchant_id.description: This field can either be the Grubhub ID for the merchant, or if an external ID is provided, it represents the external ID of the merchant.

brand.description: Indicates which brand the order originated from

confirmation_code.description: A string indicating the code required when confirming the order via a phone call. This is not required for programmatic confirmations of the order and can most likely be ignored.

when_for.description: Target fulfillment time for Pickup and Self-Delivery orders. For Pickup orders: time the order should be fully prepared and ready for handoff. For Self-Delivery orders: time the order is expected to have been delivered to the diner. For Managed Delivery orders: do not use this field; instead use fulfillmentInfo.deliveryInfo.managedDeliveryEstimatedPickup (driver pickup ready time). Integrations should treat this value as authoritative and should not recalculate it.

tax_withheld.description: TRUE indicates that sales tax has been collected on behalf of the restaurant by GH

diner_uuid.description: A Grubhub UUID identifying the diner

items.description: A Grubhub UUID identifying the diner

jit_enabled.description: Indicates if the associated restaurant has enabled just-in-time preparation for this order, where orders will be prepared only when the driver comes within a specified distance. This does not indicate that the JIT event has fired, just that `just_in_time_fired` can be expected to indicate when the driver is close enough to prepare the order.

just_in_time_fired.description: TRUE indicates that the driver is within the geofence distance and the restaurant should package the order for pickup.

Most payment types will be applied `POST_TAX`; however, loyalty rewards are applied by the merchant and therefore lower the taxable amount of the order.
